description: Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. Coverage: Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. The listing groups 80 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: CD66 Réseau routier Départemental; Réseau routier de l'Aude; Points de repères des routes départementales de l'Aude; Gestion de trafic, routes avec barrières. Formats seen: TXT, CSV, ZIP, SHP, GPKG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
